notes: Population disaggregated from WorldPop 2020 raster, calibrated to SHRUG (2013 Economic Census) and Census 2011 population and employment totals. Job counts originate from India's 2013 Economic Census (an establishment-level enumeration at each unit's physical location, not a registered-address business register), aggregated via SHRUG; spatial placement within SHRUG's reporting units uses OSM landuse polygons (industrial, retail, commercial, education) weighted by category with standard priors. Commute flows are estimated via a gravity model, then rebalanced so each area's flows sum to its measured SHRUG population/employment totals; the real 2011 Census B-28 distance-band distribution (state-level) was used to fit the gravity decay exponent, though it does not provide per-area origin-destination totals. Gravity model validated at 0% drop rate; residence/job points disaggregated to fine grid preserving total population exactly.
